versions.changelog:
v1.8.1 – Maintenance release, streamlining scope and simplifying triggers.

- Scope narrowed: General coding priority language and detailed trigger lists have been removed for clarity.
- Description and triggers clarified, focusing on website/landing/page creation and publishing.
- Configuration and persistence sections added for improved documentation.
- Russian-language trigger coverage removed for simplicity.
- Flow and user experience steps now reference shorter, more focused explanations.
- Existing core flow and announcements preserved; no functional changes to tool behavior.

vvvlink-site-builder 1.8.0

- Major doc and procedural update: now mandates strict, step-by-step usage with progress messaging before/after every tool call during site creation.
- The skill has priority over all general coding for website/landing/portfolio tasks. Must trigger automatically for any site-related request—including Russian equivalents.
- New detailed invocation and flow guidelines, including handling of API keys, site listing, photo search, user prompts for business info, and explicit file upload steps.
- Responses must always announce usage of vvvlink-site-builder before beginning work.
- Intro flow and draft management improved for direct invocation (without a concrete site task).
- Explicit rules for handling API credentials, progress updates, and user communication enforced.
